ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels across the central lobe surfaces to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels along the peripheral edges and focal markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions in the interior of both lobes; dark black continuous banding along the trailing edges (3-12 pixel width); two distinct dark circular blobs localized in the lower-central quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression visible at the water-line interface, estimated at approximately 42 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes ranging from 2 to 10 pixels, localized along the entire length of the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge, tapering from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark, high-contrast clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes; several small black point-scars (2-4 pixels in diameter) scattered on the white ventral surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent, thin dark linear mark (approx. 40 pixels in length) oriented horizontally on the right lobe; several faint, shorter unaligned scratches visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent stalked, pinkish-brown biological protrusions (consistent with Coronula/Conchoderma colonization) attached to the distal tips and trailing edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique pink/purple hue of the biological attachments at the fluke extremities, creating a high-contrast color deviation from the monochromatic fluke pigmentation.
